headline: Nigeria's Oil Sector Revenue Misses Government Budget Target by N6.11 Trillion
summary: Official reports indicate Nigeria's oil sector revenues fell N6.11 trillion short of fiscal targets in 2025. The shortfall was accompanied by a drop in NNPC receivables and rising regulatory collection costs.
why: Hydrocarbon revenues account for the majority of Nigeria's government receipts and foreign exchange earnings.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Significant oil revenue deficits widen fiscal gap pressures in Nigeria.
